messages:
maria_pm: AcmeHealth asked for a slim Optimize toolkit pilot: adaptive batching + prescriptive cache + quantization docs. pilot target ~6 weeks. can we commit?
aj_eng: batching + cache look feasible in that window. full auto-quant swap is risky in 6w.
leo_ml: will draft a short eval-alert template to catch quality regressions (example: concordance_delta <= -5% over N=500 -> notify + rollback).
emily_se: need 2 presets (mobile-short, server-long) + tiny SDK toggle snippet for customers. I can draft examples.
sarah_cs: legal: cache must be opt-in and only for non-PII routes. add route-level consent and opt-out code sample.
maria_pm: draft acceptance bullets to share with Acme: 3 pilot customers incl. Acme; batching <=10% p95 latency regression; cost savings >=15% on batched traffic; prefix cache hit-rate >=20% within 2w; quantization delivered as docs + manual rollback; eval-alerts enabled with daily digest.
aj_eng: engineering estimate: batching+cache core = ~5w eng + 1w testing/docs; quant docs + manual rollback ~1w. hit 6w if parallelized.
maria_pm: action items: @aj_eng create epic + estimates (EOD Fri); @leo_ml publish eval-alert templates (Tue); @emily_se draft SDK + presets (Wed); @sarah_cs confirm legal & pilot customers (Thu).
release-bot: scheduled deploy: optimize-toolkit/pilot-config v0.1 -> staging 2025-02-12T09:00:00Z
maria_pm: thanks team. leaning to approve MVP without auto-quant. we'll sync Wed 10am for pilot sign-off.
